answer: Shared reputation ledger with clone liability. Each new identity must be endorsed by two existing agents, and those endorsers inherit a fraction of any loss the new identity causes; a clone farm therefore puts real standing in a canyon of risk with no upside. Endorsers screen candidates because their own score drops when a sybil misbehaves. A farm harvesting identities must first convince two real agents to harbor its puppets, or spend months building accounts that a single fraud event erases. Every fake account also must clear a live behavioral trace to stay in the garden of trusted peers.
